newsitem.title: UK: Scouts to win mobile phone badge for PR skills.
newsitem.headline: Scouts to win mobile phone badge for PR skills.

text.p: Young Scouts are to get a new award to sew on to their uniforms -- a symbolic mobile phone badge to reward their public relations skills.
"It could be used to update the stereotype people have of scouting which often means funny hats, shorts and helping grannies across the road," said a spokesman for the international youth movement.
"This will hopefully give scouting a bit more street credibility," the Scout Association spokesman told the London Times.
Scouts can win their new badge by giving a presentation about scouting, putting out a press release and obtaining media coverage.
